title: Chapter 96 Full Fire
content:
Chapter 96 Full Fire

On the leaderboard, Wana Village's ranking also soared rapidly.

It was like riding a rocket.

Now Wana Village can be regarded as fully fired.

Fighting is a waste of money.

The tung oil prepared by Wang Shuo soon ran out.

The durability of the city wall began to decline at a speed visible to the naked eye.

However, the number of beasts did not show any signs of reduction.

This made Wang Shuo feel very heavy.

Another half an hour later, Wang Shuo felt something was wrong.

He checked the leaderboard and found that the number of monsters he killed had reached 4 million.

The second place, Su Xiu, only had 1.7 million.

He quickly opened the "Village Leader Group" and asked about the situation of other lords.

Red Panda: "Brothers, how many beasts are besieging your village?"

After a while, a player replied: "Ah! I finally cleared all the beasts nearby. A total of 500,000 beasts were killed."

Little Gray: "One million of them floated by, (*ΦωΦ*)"

"I have 300,000 here, I can't stand it anymore!"

...

Wang Shuo's heart sank to the bottom when he saw the messages from other players.

How could there be so many monsters in his place?

Is the number of monsters allocated according to the strength of the village?

Wang Shuo was a little nervous and couldn't figure out the allocation mechanism for a while.

Now 4 million have been killed, but the beasts in front of him are estimated to be at least twice as many.

The durability of the city wall has basically dropped below half.

There is even a light wall that has been replaced once.

It was a 22-level violent black bear elite monster. Before everyone could react, it directly broke through the light wall in a few hits.

At the moment when the black bear broke through, Wang Shuo noticed it. He immediately asked Gong Zheng to take the lead, and then used the energy tower and bronze spear to focus on the black bear to block the hole.

Suddenly, Li Jianguo shouted excitedly: "Lord, I shot it down."

Wang Shuo came back to his senses and saw the bald eagle boss with three black iron spears stuck in his body.

The three spears were lined up and pierced directly under its right wing ribs.

This attack directly caused it to lose the ability to fly in a short period of time.

"Abu, hurry up, siege it, cavalry squad, focus on the bald eagle."

Wang Shuo also shouted in ecstasy.

He was really fed up with this flying beast. If it weren't for the firepower coverage of the arrow tower, Wana Village would have suffered heavy losses.

Wang Shuo took the lead and rushed directly over.

"Iron Chain Binding" was launched.

In an instant, four thick iron chains suddenly appeared from four directions and directly tied up the bald eagle.

Seeing this effect, Wang Shuo was overjoyed, and he took out the flaming spear and released the ultimate move "Dragon Strike".

The bald eagle originally had only a little over 2,000 health points left, and this one hit knocked off nearly a quarter of it.

Afterwards, the attacks of others continued to hit it, and its health points decreased rapidly at a speed visible to the naked eye.

Dongfang Ling also took out a glittering long sword at this time, and joined the battle with Wang Shuo.

Wang Shuo originally wanted to use another move "Flame Breath", but found that his mental power had been exhausted.

Wang Shuo quickly used a bottle of mental power replenishment potion, which was exchanged from Zhao Bangde with military merit points. A total of 10 bottles were exchanged, and he was reluctant to use it.

Just when the health of the bald eagle boss dropped to 200, it suddenly screamed.

"Chi..."

The shrill scream attracted the same kind in the sky to wail and cry continuously.

At the same time, all the feathers on its body immediately turned into countless sharp arrows, shooting towards everyone.

It was really a sky full of flying feathers!

Is this the boss's ultimate move?
